summary: Phase 1 verification of Asgard CodeAudit (backend FastAPI + SQLite, frontend Vite/React preview). Ran full internal pytest suite (22/22 pass) and authored a new external-ingress suite hitting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL that validates F03/F06/F08 + name normalization (11/11 pass). Performed UI smoke via Playwright: boot indicator, build identity, preview badge/banner, register fixture, remove-with-source-untouched toast, diagnostics real runtime values. No functional issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostics: 'Python' version is shown under Build identity card, not inside data-testid=diag-storage. Not a bug — the review spec's diag-storage testid only wraps the SQLite panel. Consider adding a data-testid on the Build identity card if future tests want a single anchor.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console — harmless but opt-in flags could be added.
Alembic config emits a PendingDeprecationWarning about path_separator; add `path_separator=os` in alembic.ini to future-proof.
Preview-only endpoint POST /api/v1/projects with only {name} (no fixture_id, no path) currently returns 403 by design; the spec text says 403 — matches. Kept assertion tolerant (403 or 422).
test_credentials: No user login. Preview auto-issues bearer via POST /api/v1/dev/session (same-origin). Backend unit tests use TEST_SECRET='t'*40 per conftest.
seed_data_creation: Test created + cleaned up TEST_ prefixed fixture registrations (py-fastapi-sample, js-react-sample).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is stable with parallel xdist. External suite requires disabling xdist due to shared preview state (used `-o addopts=''`). If re-running, cleanup helper _cleanup_fixture removes leftover active fixtures via DELETE before each POST 201 check. UI data-testids match spec exactly. Electron/desktop items (native picker, stdin-secret, installer) intentionally not verified — require Windows.
